notes: Payable grants of a group (VN_TRNSTYPE_PASSWORD types, VN_SUPPLIER_PASSWORD supplier ranges; read by APP_RULES_VN / APP_PROC_VN); range checks, all types and select all / none buttons (APP_RULES3_SE, see processes/VNPASS.md)

after_save.name: مدى الموردين غير متداخل

VN_SUPPLIER_PASSWORD.FROM_SUPPLIER_CODE.lov: select code || ' - ' || case when app_sec.lang = 'en' then nvl(name_e, name_a) else name_a end d, code r from supplier order by 1

VN_SUPPLIER_PASSWORD.TO_SUPPLIER_CODE.lov: select code || ' - ' || case when app_sec.lang = 'en' then nvl(name_e, name_a) else name_a end d, code r from supplier where :PAGE_FROM_SUPPLIER_CODE is null or code >= :PAGE_FROM_SUPPLIER_CODE order by 1 desc

params.name: FLAG
params.lov_sql: select case when app_sec.lang = 'en' then e else a end d, r from (select 'إختيار الكل' a, 'Select all' e, 1 r from dual union all select 'استبعاد الكل', 'Deselect all', 0 from dual) order by r desc
